title: The Restrictions for BuddyPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in all versions up to, and…
description: The Restrictions for BuddyPress plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 1.5.4 contains a critical remote code execution vulnerability. This flaw arises from unsafe use of eval() on attacker-controlled request URIs, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary PHP code via a crafted GET request. The vulnerability is exploitable without authentication and requires the presence of BuddyPress and Paid Memberships Pro plugins. No plugin configuration changes are needed to trigger the flaw.
